propositions: Anthropic and OpenAI usage rows fail to price and silently drop to unpriced when model_ref is stored with provider prefix (e.g., anthropic:claude-sonnet-4-6) but genai-prices only resolves bare model ids (e.g., claude-sonnet-4-6)

Bedrock usage rows incidentally resolve and price despite the prefix because its remainder form happens to match genai-prices AWS id shape, creating an asymmetric cost comparison that biases toward Bedrock as appearing more expensive

LookupError raised by genai_prices is caught and converted to unpriced without warning, making the pricing failure indistinguishable from genuinely unknown models and hiding the systematic mis-formatting

Provider-aware id translation must be decided by REGISTRY MEMBERSHIP of known providers rather than string prefix splitting, because simple colon-split breaks versioned AWS ids like anthropic.claude-haiku-4-5-20251001-v1:0
Cost reporting output must distinguish genuinely unknown models (bare, unpriced) from mis-formatted ids (with malformed prefix, visibly unpriced) so silent failures become observable
